WireInfoContainer

WireInfo Pattern Property

All properties whose name matches the following regular expression must respect the following conditions

Property name regular expression: ^.+$
root WireInfo
Type: object

Wire data that can be specified per line segment phase, or for the line segment as a whole in case its phases all have the same wire characteristics.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root WireInfo anyOf WireInfo IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root WireInfo anyOf WireInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root WireInfo anyOf OverheadWireInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root WireInfo anyOf CableInfo IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root WireInfo anyOf CableInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root WireInfo anyOf CableInfo IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root WireInfo anyOf TapeShieldCableInfo IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root WireInfo anyOf TapeShieldCableInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root WireInfo anyOf ConcentricNeutralCableInfo IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root WireInfo anyOf ConcentricNeutralCableInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

WireInfo.insulated

root WireInfo anyOf ConcentricNeutralCableInfo WireInfo.insulated
Type: boolean

True if conductor is insulated.
